g.text: Rastok — bird's-eye module overview (M1.4 instance rebase, 2026-08-18)
node — shared graph and execution vocabulary
envelope — data and metadata carried through the graph
diagnostics — structured diagnostics shared across phases
datatype / value — core logical data authority
json — exact JSON document reader and writer
boundary — contracts with the external world
journal — durable causal history and recovery model
golden — canonical projection, seal, and diff
absence or declared class of effect
the CAUSE a committed transaction records
the PATTERN a handler declares (≠ Trigger)
exactly sys, app, and ext metadata zones
raw, Avro, or Arrow IPC encoding
checked landing site of a builder write
stable diagnostic identity and structured details
registry code carrying severity by prefix
parse, resolve, check, plan, run, replay, or simulation
logical type tree and recursive conformance judge
one materialized domain and structural validator
names and types visible to an expression
transient core value or lazy payload witness
one bit form for each canonical double
typed malformed, non-canonical, or over-budget input
one extend-only value alphabet for plans and traces
int, uint, or exact decimal under hard budgets
one house codec shared by literals and jsonl
exact logical projection and reverse capability check
comment extent, termination, and multiline fact
recognition only; each consumer owns policy
valid plan, symbols, hash, warnings, and checked labs
owns the only byte cursor and token lookahead
desugared, resolved, and typed graph + labs
graph, operator, or connector with its resolved contract
no placeholder type until one implementation lands
parent-linked owner tree plus scoped edges and handlers
plan plus total effective port types
exact declared/inferred type of every port
graph, operator, or connector with its spec
typed effect, behavior, and effective phase-tagged attributes
optional key expression and independent lifetime profile
choice word or constant Rastok expression
choice, scalar constant, or deferred composite domain
available sheet, declared name, or unknown capability
selects an available or deferred profile
validated sheets and declared capability names
declared language name and current availability
starts calls, answers or stays silent, cancels on demand
admits every typed port draft before call closure
supplies one due event at a time (current driver uses target advance)
supplies lifecycle events (current build: boot only)
starts journaled calls, settles gated closures
events, discarded, uncorrelated, rejected — nothing silent
exact request bytes sealed with their digest
Process lines, jsonl, or bytes framing
pure framing and Process port-type authority
ordered drafts ending in exactly one exit
exact terminal union for one Process invocation
delivery budget or Node-instance lifetime event
pure engine — boot, inject, step, drain, pump, advance
deterministic work picking; the dated-event queue
bounded FIFO queues per instance reference
one queued envelope with its port, edge, and seq
private Node state cells indexed by instance reference
owner path plus outer-to-inner canonical frames
one logged delivery — the observation surface
engine refusal returned to supervision, transaction uncommitted
instance ref, parent ref, consumed, delta, emissions, routes, cause
identity recipes — root, emission, call, budget
canonical record bytes with their structured trees
first difference, by record and named key path
project, seal, diff over shared canonical CBOR
pre-bound async process adapter; out*, err*, then typed exit
refuses an unserved or unresolved plan before VM boot
declared names — sheets and adapters land by slice
builds the adapter behind the production Partner seam
passed, failed, and honestly unproven cases
one executed scenario — verdict and journal records
run — drives scenarios on the production Vm
the compiled sources spans resolve against
wiring and verbs; owns nothing semantic
Representative load-bearing modules and types (public or
architecturally named) ; no fields, no methods, no type-level arrows.
ownership edges, and build artifacts are deliberately not shown.
Incidental arrows into the shared `node`, `envelope`, and
owns neither DataType nor materialized Value;
compatible operations retain the CEL oracle
the scenario forms live in compiler::hir (one
parser, one checker) ; the fixture IS the scenario's
steps ; virtual time IS Vm::advance — no separate
